base.rule: superseding: 1.4 is unchanged; 1.5 preserves its accepted shapes but deliberately replaces the cloud-ChatGPT rejection with the relay-bound source

POST /api/matrix/v1/connections/byo.credential_ingress: TLS to fixed-provider encrypt-only API; raw keys are not any message in this pack

owner_private.description: Owner-private Matrix account data, never room state.

owner_to_platform.description: Authenticated owner changes only their AI settings. Owner identity is derived by the server.

runtime_to_owner.description: Sanitized model/runtime offers to the authenticated owner.

answer_to_owner.description: Source stamp for owner-only rooms; omitted for any non-owner human.

platform_to_gateway.description: Bounded BYO descriptor; key material is decrypted only inside the gateway.

contract_fixture.description: Product vocabulary mappings; they do not enable live capabilities.

destination_owner_to_provider.description: The authenticated owner changes one agent destination choice or daily cap; owner and agent identities are server-derived.

destination_provider_to_owner.description: Sanitized per-destination choices, recommendation, cap and spend state for the authenticated owner.

row: Owner 2026-10-27/28 R2: source-aware ChatGPT-plan choice for cloud agents through one owner Mac

amendments.change: policy 2026-10-17.1 contains Nguyệt Thực 1.3 on GPT-6 Luna and Nhật Thực 1.1 on GPT-6.1 Sol; Thái Cực has no server alias and remains a client-only disabled row
Nguyệt Thực keeps its existing pin and budgets; Nhật Thực uses 120000 input and 16384 output so its worst hold stays below the unchanged 20000-Proton turn ceiling

when this policy activates, a saved choice whose alias is absent from the two-row map is atomically rewritten to the server recommendation at a higher revision and produces a visible policy-change notice; the server never emits an invalid snapshot or silently preserves a retired provider route
the provider wire profile remains atum.model-choice/1.1; no route, flag, migration, dispatch alias or production value changes in this contract pack
the server stores at most one choice per destination; cloud accepts only Atum, while ChatGPT-plan and own-key choices remain Mac-local and secret-free

daily spend state is derived from the configured cap: cap 0 is always normal, otherwise below 80 percent is normal, 80 percent through below 100 percent is warning, and at or above 100 percent is exhausted after the completed call

a cloud destination may name source opencode_go with a model from the server-owned subscription catalogue; the choice is stored per agent and revokes with the owner's connection. ChatGPT-plan and own-key sources stay Mac-local. No credential crosses this contract

an active subscription grant names source opencode_go, the exact model and effort, the provider catalogue digest, its context/output budgets and maxTurnMicroProtons 0. The managed Proton gateway refuses it; a revoked connection makes it unavailable with reason provider_unavailable, never an Atum fallback

a cloud destination may name source chatgpt_plan only while the owner has one active relay Mac and that Mac advertises the selected model. The grant binds the relay device and relay revision, spends zero Atum Protons, and never falls back to source atum when the Mac is offline or the relay is disabled
